name: dsh-rofm
description: DSH 长期记忆插件：上下文超过阈值时把最早的一段对话归档进 memory/ 回忆文件夹（v1.4.1 起每次归档至少压到 releaseTargetPercent 以下），之后按关键词（双向匹配）、确定性优先级 α（FAIR-DRI）与可选时间/事件/地点/人物/时间标签约束自动回忆；v1.5.0 起支持四类标签硬过滤、多事件、自适应配额 20、多子句逐题作答与「你说过」助手原话召回。 · DSH long-term memory: archives the earliest context into memory/ folders, then recalls it deterministically by keywords, priority α, time windows, events and location/person/time tags (v1.5.0 adds hard tag filters, multi-event, adaptive quota 20, multi-clause recall and assistant-utterance recall).

scripts.check: node --test && node test/simulate.mjs && node tools/selfcheck.mjs && node tools/privacy-check.mjs && node engine/cli.mjs --help

author: dsh-rofm contributors
